articles.title: Elon Musk could become a top 5 corporate bitcoin holder if Tesla and SpaceX merge
articles.snippet: CNBC reported Tuesday that Musk is discussing a merger between Tesla and SpaceX that would tie his tech empire closer together and instantly create the world’s fifth-largest corporate bitcoin treasury, worth $3.3 billion.

articles.title: A bipartisan bridge to the future: Why the Senate must finish the job on digital Assets
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act’s recent markup proved that the momentum for regulation is there. It is imperative that Congress move the bill forward to establish rules this generation needs and a framework the next will inherit, urges Kim.

articles.title: IREN shares jumps on $1.6 billion Dell deal to expand AI cloud business
articles.snippet: The Dell agreement will support IREN’s expanding AI cloud business and boost projected annualized revenue to $4.4 billion by 2027.

articles.title: HTX denies UK sanctions allegations as new data flags $7.6B Russia-linked flows
articles.snippet: UK sanctions Huobi Global S.A., operator of HTX, over alleged role in Russia’s “A7” shadow network, as new analysis claims the exchange handled billions in high‑risk flows.

articles.title: Bitcoin price shrugs off $1.3B BlackRock ETF block sale
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s price stayed firm despite a massive $1.3 billion block sale executed by a mysterious BlackRock ETF holder, which analysts called a sign of large-scale institutional de-risking.
